title: 1 / CURRENCY ( 3 ) is the decimal number 0.3333333333333333, not the fixed decimal 0.3333

source.quote: The result is always decimal, unless a currency is divided by an integer or by a decimal; in this case, the result is currency
source.supports: an integer divided by a currency is a decimal number; a currency divided by an integer is a currency

source.quote: if a division operation combines an integer with a currency value, DAX converts both values to real numbers, and the result is also a real number
source.supports: INTEGER / CURRENCY is REAL according to this sentence; the table above it has CURRENCY in that cell

derivation: SQLBI's division table and the sentence under Microsoft's table both give a decimal (real) number for an integer divided by a currency. 1 / 3 as a double is 0.3333333333333333.
alternative: The cell of Microsoft's division table for INTEGER / CURRENCY says CURRENCY. Under that reading the result is the fixed decimal 0.3333.
